const RS_READ: u32 = 100u32;
const RS_MUT: u32 = 101u32;
const RS_MOVE: u32 = 102u32;
const RS_DEFER: u32 = 103u32;
const RS_UNSAFE: u32 = 104u32;
const RS_FORGET: u32 = 105u32;

record RsResource {
    declaration: *RmdDecl;
    drop_name: *RmdName;
    next: *RsResource;
}

record RsGlobal {
    source: *RmdDecl;
    lowered: *RmdDecl;
    syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax;
    resource: *RsResource;
    unsafe_call: bool;
    drop_only: bool;
    drop: *RsGlobal;
    next: *RsGlobal;
}

record RsStage {
    context: *RmdContext;
    sources: *RmdUnit;
    resources: *RsResource;
    globals: RmdMap;
    first_global: *RsGlobal;
    last_global: *RsGlobal;
    unsafe_functions: RmdMap;
    lowered_types: RmdMap;
    ownership: RmdMap;
    functions: RmdMap;
    next_name: usize;
    failed: bool;
}

record RsScope {
    parent: *RsScope;
    first: *RsLocal;
    first_action: *RsAction;
    last_action: *RsAction;
}

record RsLocal {
    name: *RmdName;
    syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax;
    storage: *RmdName;
    indirect: bool;
    initialized: bool;
    owning: bool;
    mode: u32;
    readers: usize;
    exclusive: bool;
    parent_loan: *RsLocal;
    stamp: usize;
    scope: *RsScope;
    next: *RsLocal;
}

record RsValue {
    syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax;
    expression: *RmdExpr;
    local: *RsLocal;
    mode: u32;
    owned: bool;
    unsafe_call: bool;
}

record RsAction {
    owner: *RsLocal;
    statement: *RmdStmt;
    validated: bool;
    next: *RsAction;
}

record RsChain {
    action: *RsAction;
    next: *RsChain;
    identity: usize;
    hash_next: *RsChain;
    all_next: *RsChain;
}

record RsExit {
    chain: *RsChain;
    continuation: *RsChain;
}

record RsChange {
    local: *RsLocal;
    initialized: bool;
    readers: usize;
    exclusive: bool;
    next: *RsChange;
}

record RsLoop {
    parent: *RsLoop;
    scope: *RsScope;
    break_target: *RsChain;
    continue_target: *RsChain;
    entry: *RsChange;
    has_break: bool;
}

record RsFunction {
    stage: *RsStage;
    global: *RsGlobal;
    locals: RmdMap;
    scope: *RsScope;
    loop: *RsLoop;
    changes: *RsChange;
    declarations: *RmdStmt;
    last_declaration: *RmdStmt;
    validation: *RmdStmt;
    last_validation: *RmdStmt;
    exits: RmdMap;
    loop_targets: RmdMap;
    seed_blocks: RmdMap;
    chain_map: RmdMap;
    chains: *RsChain;
    next_label: usize;
    result: *RsLocal;
    output: *RmdName;
    returned: *RsChain;
    body: *RmdStmt;
    epilogue: *RmdStmt;
    unsafe_depth: usize;
    stamp: usize;
    expression_depth: u32;
}

record RsStatements { first: *RmdStmt; last: *RmdStmt; }
